examples.explanation: The bulbs[0] = 10th light bulb is currently off. We switch it on. The bulbs[1] = 30th light bulb is currently off. We switch it on. The bulbs[2] = 20th light bulb is currently off. We switch it on. The bulbs[3] = 10th light bulb is currently on. We switch it off. In the end, the 20th and the 30th light bulbs are on.
The bulbs[0] = 100th light bulb is currently off. We switch it on. The bulbs[1] = 100th light bulb is currently on. We switch it off. In the end, no light bulb is on.
